_doc: Single source of truth for the format-microbench grid. Read by BOTH src/bin/format_microbench.rs (when building the grid) AND papers/scripts/verify_format_microbench_freshness.py (when checking that every expected cell exists). Adding a d_model or init here will (a) make the next grid run produce new cells and (b) make the freshness gate FAIL until those cells exist on disk. Loop 151 A closure of 71st-pass SEV-3.
